name: Microsoft 365 security dashboard
summary: Five-tab dashboard: threat intel, sign-in geography, admin activity, data movement, pipeline health
description:
Built to complement the alerts rather than repeat them: context for triage, signals too slow to alert on, and feed health that makes silent failures visible.

After importing, point the widgets at your own stream(s). Several panels need the enrichment pipeline in pipeline/ - the Threat intel tab and the unrecognised-applications panels are empty without it.

Three deliberate choices worth keeping: every geo panel filters Operation:UserLoggedIn, because ClientIP is whoever called the API and without that filter the maps plot Microsoft datacenters; failed sign-ins filter to LogonError:InvalidUserNameOrPassword, because unfiltered UserLoginFailed is mostly MFA interrupts; and file downloads are charted over time rather than ranked, because exfiltration is a spike.
